page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.6xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores utilizing the x86_64 architecture, driven by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a baseline frequency of 2.7 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.r7.6xlarge demonstrates solid, mid-range performance across multiple computational and memory metrics. Its single-core and multi-core CPU capabilities, measured via stress-ng and Geekbench, fall within the average range for its hardware class. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only speeds of 1263.88 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 129.12 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside a write speed of 62.93 GB/sec. Notably, the instance exhibits strong performance in text generation for small language models, achieving 283.7 tokens per second, which places it in the top 25% tier, while medium-sized model inference remains average.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density provide a stable environment for memory-bound workloads without the overhead of GPU hardware or local NVMe storage. This resource profile makes the ecs.r7.6xlarge highly suitable for memory-intensive enterprise applications, database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, and software compilation tasks.
